phaseGate.input: Verified Phase 05 Core/native schema, capability and provenance boundary.
phaseGate.output: Frontend-neutral Canonical IR semantic, origin, effect, mutation and BB-only SchedulingRegion contracts.
phaseGate.authorityBoundary: Canonical IR and scheduling regions are compiler-owned facts only; runtime legality, execution, publication, commit and retire remain runtime-owned.
phaseGate.deterministicFallback: Unknown semantic or frontend-specific state is rejected before scheduling; unknown memory effects conservatively alias; region expansion remains disabled.

contracts.sourceIdentityRule: Stable frontend identity plus ordered origin chain; enumeration order is not identity.

contracts.derivedFactRule: Schedule-changing mutation increments the program stamp and invalidates dependency, liveness, pressure, MII and placement facts.
contracts.nativeNopeRule: The architectural zero carrier is the sole catalog-gap compatibility no-op; every other unknown opcode fails closed.

initialCompilerFocusedFailure.cause: Generated opcode metadata omits the architectural zero-carrier Nope compatibility value.
